name: glpi-plugin-manageentities
description: Version pinning of the third-party bundles vendored under public/lib/, so that npm audit and Dependabot can see them. The plugin has no JavaScript build step: installing this manifest produces no artefact the plugin uses. Nothing is pinned because nothing is vendored any more -- every front-end library the plugin draws on is the one GLPI core ships; see public/lib/VERSIONS.md.
